name: ml-research
description: Contracted co-scientist: run baseline and candidate branches under a locked evaluation contract, rank them across seeds, ablate the winner and write a grounded report.
author: zorai

mlflow_url.label: MLflow server
mlflow_url.description: Runs are also logged here when a server answers; leave empty to keep them only in results.db

sql_row_limit.label: SQL row limit
sql_row_limit.description: Most rows the data console returns (up to 5000)

run.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py check
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py example
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py open
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py spec
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py lock
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py sweep
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py ablate
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py report
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py paper
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py audit
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py sql

check.description: Show GPU, uv, git, Hugging Face and MLflow readiness. Add --campaign <name> to check its contract

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py check --format markdown

open.description: Register a git repo with an experiment.yaml as a campaign. Add --campaign <name> --folder <repo>

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py open

lock.description: Pin the protected evaluation files of a campaign so runs cannot change them. Add --campaign <name>

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py lock

sweep.description: Run the baseline and candidate branches over all seeds in separate worktrees, several at once when experiment.yaml sets parallel. Add --campaign <name> --wait [--parallel N --gpus 0,1]

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py sweep --format markdown

leaderboard.description: Rank candidates by the campaign metric with mean ± std and contract status. Add --campaign <name>

ablate.description: Revert each changed file of the winning branch in turn to show what caused the gain. Add --campaign <name> --wait [--parallel N --gpus 0,1]

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py ablate --format markdown

report.description: Write a Markdown report with tables, a plot and run citations. Add --campaign <name>

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py report --format markdown

data-sql.description: Run a read-only DuckDB query over local or hf:// Parquet/CSV. Add --query "<sql>"

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py sql --format markdown

paper.description: Build a grounded paper workspace: evidence.json with every number and its run ids, plus a manuscript.md skeleton with tables. Add --campaign <name> [--force true]

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py paper --format markdown

audit.description: Check that every number in the campaign's manuscript.md matches evidence.json; lists sentences with invented numbers. Add --campaign <name>

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/ml_research.py audit --format markdown

runtimes.description: Readiness of Prime Intellect Verifiers, AutoResearch and AutoRL for a workspace, with setup and launch commands. Add --workspace <folder>

commands.title: Start a research campaign
commands.prompt: Use the ml-research plugin to set up a research campaign for {{goal}} in {{folder}}: write experiment.yaml with a metric and the protected evaluation files, lock the contract, implement candidate branches, sweep them across seeds, ablate the winner and write the report. Do not edit the protected files.

inputs.label: What should improve?
inputs.placeholder: validation loss of the tokenizer experiment
